about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Katherine M. Clark

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HIGHLIGHTING THE UCS TOWN HALL
statements.title: HIGHLIGHTING THE UCS TOWN HALL
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I recently had the privilege of joining the Union of Concerned Scientists and more than 300 of my constituents for a town hall to discuss the Trump administration's continued, devastating attacks on science.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE THE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBL
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE THE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: Mr. Speaker, we have been at war with Iran for 2\1/2\ months.
Shipping is still blockaded, and negotiations that should be about making sure Iran never gets a nuclear weapon are completely stalled out.
Once again, they have a chance to side with working families and our troops.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
sentences: Mr. Speaker, 6 weeks ago, Democrats brought a War Powers Resolution to this House floor.
President Donald Trump told us because of this war: It is not possible for us to take care of daycare, Medicaid, Medicare.
Are you going to continue to enable him and his madness, or are you going to prioritize Americans, the working families of this country, and vote ``yes'' for this resolution?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PAY OUR HOMELAND DEFENDERS ACT
statements.title: PAY OUR HOMELAND DEFENDERS ACT
sentences: He will not allow airports to get back to normal unless we make it harder to vote and harder to register to vote, unless we drown voters in red tape and ban mail-in voting, except for the President.
Let's pay TSA workers, and we can have an ICE operation that works like every other police department across the country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPU
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: Republicans have been raiding their healthcare, their Social Security, and their veterans benefits, all to enrich the billionaire class.
Illegal tariffs are jacking up prices.
Secret police are murdering Americans in the streets.

Today, you can join us in telling the President that the Constitution is not just a suggestion; that our country belongs to its people, to the American people; that the power to declare war belongs to the people's Representatives; and that 250 years later, whatever Donald Trump may think, America still has no kings.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Republicans aren't worried about noncitizens voting.
Also, billionaires can weasel out of paying their fair share.
They are trying to say this is a voter ID bill.
They fear they will never find childcare they can afford.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: First, they refused to ensure ICE abides by the same laws and procedures as our local and State police: that they are unmasked when on duty, that they actually wear the body cameras, that they wear a name plate identifying who they are, and that they are held responsible for excessive force.
Finally, Republicans refused to prioritize the very real work that DHS does in our communities: stopping fentanyl trafficking, stopping child trafficking, and stopping cartels.
I will not rubberstamp the Federal Government's use of political violence against its own people, and I am asking every Member to join me in voting ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: Today, thanks to the strength and unity of our Democratic Caucus, the House will vote to restore the ACA tax credits, and I will vote to restore the affordable marketplace plans that working people depend on to stay healthy, to live, to survive.
Today, I will vote to prioritize the lives of regular people over the greed of billionaires and start bringing the Republican healthcare crisis to an end.
We still have to reverse their cuts to Medicaid and Medicare.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
statements.title: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
sentences: It does promote the GOP dream of a nationwide abortion ban.
Let's stop the premium hikes, extend the ACA tax credits, and get back to building a healthcare system that is worthy of the American people.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EPSTEIN FILES TRANSPARENCY ACT
statements.title: EPSTEIN FILES TRANSPARENCY ACT
sentences: This is about justice for the victims and survivors of Jeffrey Epstein.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Donald Trump said the cost- of-living crisis is fake news, ``a con job by the Democrats.'' Mr. Speaker, 60 percent of Americans can't afford a basic quality of life, 45 percent have had to skip a doctor's appointment or a prescription because they can't afford it, and 41 percent are living with medical debt.
This is the crisis of our time, and it is about to get exponentially worse because of the GOP's craven allegiance to billionaires over working people.
The cost-of-living crisis is not fake news.
Let's stop the hospital closures, and let's stop the billionaire giveaways.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FAREWELL ALLISON BLANKENSHIP
statements.title: FAREWELL ALLISON BLANKENSHIP
sentences: We will not forget Allison, and we hope she will not forget us. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: This is an existential failure of the wealthiest Nation on Earth.
They are voting to enrich billionaires at the expense of what makes us American, which is our freedom to build a better life for our families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: My colleagues on the other side of the aisle are cutting half a trillion dollars from Medicare and hiking the costs of everyday items with their tariffs, all to fund tax breaks for the billionaire class.
That alone is a betrayal of working families, but the GOP is not stopping there.

Today, Republicans are threatening their physical security because when you defund public broadcasting, you are defunding emergency broadcasts during hurricane season, tornado season, and wildfire season.
Here is what my Republican colleagues fundamentally don't seem to understand: There is no security for billionaires in this country without security for a hungry child.
In the words of President Kennedy: ``If a free society cannot help the many who are poor, it cannot save the few who are rich.'' Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to please vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
sentences: Medicaid pays for the daily care this little boy needs to survive.
Rachel wrote: ``We are terrified about what losing Medicaid support would mean for our family.'' Moms have enough to deal with.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISAPPROVING THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION RELATING TO "OVERDRAFT LENDING: VERY LARGE FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS"
statements.title: DISAPPROVING THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION RELATING TO "OVERDRAFT LENDING: VERY LARGE FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS"
sentences: Later today, Republicans will be back on their tax plan, the one where they take deserving taxpayer dollars and give them to the billionaire class in the form of tax cuts for them.

By defunding Medicaid, the largest healthcare program in our country, by defunding food programs that feed 15 million children, by dismantling Social Security, firing veterans, closing and cutting public schools, and abandoning special needs children, the rich will get richer.
Mr. Speaker, we will continue to work and vote for working people, and we will vote ``no'' on this budget.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FAREWELL TO TWO TALENTED STAFFERS
statements.title: FAREWELL TO TWO TALENTED STAFFERS
sentences: More times than I can count, I met a district director halfway across the country, and when I introduced myself as a Congresswoman, they would say: Wait, you work with Wendy Hamilton?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FULL-YEAR CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2025
statements.title: FULL-YEAR CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2025
sentences: We all want government to run more efficiently, to be better for people who depend on it, but stealing money from the Veterans Administration, from schools, from law enforcement, from children's healthcare and giving it to a tax cut to the wealthiest man on Earth and his billionaire friends is not finding efficiencies.
It is destroying working families.
Then if we look at the budget overall, we have got healthcare spiking, and you want to cut Medicaid.
Seniors' cost of living is out of control, and Republicans are saying let's run up the cost of prescription drugs.
As Elon told us directly this week, coming next Republicans want to eliminate Social Security.
We are going to build a stronger economy, we are going to lower costs, and we are going to have safer communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: Madam Chair, despite all the promises on the campaign trail, House Republicans have chosen to do three things with their majority: raise the cost of putting food on the table, raise the cost of getting healthcare, and use that money, deserving taxpayers' money, to cut billionaires' taxes.
Do you know what it costs to keep a kid on Medicaid?
They want to give $6 million per billionaire.
For a billionaire, $6 million is not even a rounding error.
Inflicting hunger on children to give billionaires money they don't need and won't even notice, there is no moral code under which that is acceptable.
There is no logical reason for it other than total fealty to billionaire donors, billionaires who will never feel they have enough.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ATTACK ON THE CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION BUREAU
statements.title: ATTACK ON THE CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION BUREAU
sentences: Most people haven't heard of the CFPB, but Americans know the corporate greed that they have gone after on their behalf for more than a decade: the predatory loan sharks and the abusive debt collectors.
That is $5 billion back in the pockets of working families every year, over $200 per family.
Apparently, Republicans in Congress would rather have that money go into the pockets of CEOs and spend that money cutting billionaires' taxes instead of fighting fraud and corporate abuse.
They didn't vote to have our servicemembers go into more debt.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BORN-ALIVE ABORTION SURVIVORS PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: BORN-ALIVE ABORTION SURVIVORS PROTECTION ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Republicans have one goal today, and that is a march toward a national abortion ban.
I learned during a routine sonogram that the doctors could no longer pick up a heartbeat.
My doctor said that I would need abortion care to prevent infection.

When the time came and I needed to have this procedure to protect my own health and be the mother I wanted to be for my children, I asked one more time to please check that that heartbeat was there before they did this procedure.
OB/GYNs are fleeing States with abortion bans and leaving the field all together.
For example, under Georgia's abortion ban, currently half of the counties don't have a single obstetrician.
I will mention what happened to me.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: I urge my colleagues to reject this bill and say ``no'' on empowering predators.
